message.content:
The total number of distinct legal positions that can arise in a standard game of chess is estimated to be on the order of 10⁴³ (roughly 10 trillion trillion trillion).  

If you’re asking about the size of the entire game‑tree (all possible sequences of moves from start to finish), the classic estimate is the **Shannon number** ≈ 10¹²³ (about one hundred and twenty‑one nonillion).
